applicable_sections: section 8 creative Draft and typed binding intent boundary
section 12 provider transport and repair constraints

root_cause: A4 had declared stage signatures but its B1 transport schema still encoded retired pre-v3 fields (audio_intents, reference_intents, duration_weight, and untyped camera fields). The schema registry correctly failed closed against the frozen ExecutionDesignDraft, so B1 could not reach the provider. The compiler also treated approved input as descriptive rather than an enforced transport boundary, and the local validator could not enforce the nullable typed reference target or opaque fact-handle shape.

alternatives_considered.option: Relax the canonical Draft-contract check so the old B1 schema can run.
alternatives_considered.reason: That would let a superseded field set define v3.0 provider output and would permit free-text binding transport.

alternatives_considered.option: Add compatibility aliases for old B1 fields alongside the v3.0 typed fields.
alternatives_considered.reason: Aliases create two competing creative contracts and leave a path for model-originated timing and implicit binding semantics.

alternatives_considered.option: Accept arbitrary approved-input keys and rely on prompt wording to ignore them.
alternatives_considered.reason: Prompt wording is not an authorization boundary; the compiler must reject undeclared fields before prompt serialization.

repair: Rebased all A4 stage signatures to v3.0 and attached an explicit per-stage approved-input key allowlist enforced by PromptCompiler before serialization.

Replaced the retired B1 schema with the frozen ExecutionDesignDraft surface: creative shot ordinal, duration intent, generation mode, composition, camera, lighting, performance, visual beats, typed reference binding intents, typed dialogue binding intents, transitions, and handoff only.
Made reference and dialogue bindings closed typed records using opaque fh:<sha256> handles; removed all free-text reference and audio binding fields from B1.
Extended local deterministic schema decoding for anyOf, null, and regular-expression patterns so nullable beat targets and opaque handles are checked before a ModelDraft is accepted.
Hardened structured text evidence, violation, and patch digests to lowercase SHA-256; constrained I0 repair scope to fact source_start/source_end only.

Kept the native Windows claude.exe-first provider selection and one-scoped-ContractPatch budget; no provider fallback, runtime launch, VEC assembly, timeline allocation, Projection, v4 path, or production switch was changed.

checks.name: stage_signatures_declared
checks.evidence: All five stages have frozen v3.0 signatures with positive prompt/schema budgets and machine-enforced approved-input key sets.

checks.name: prompt_schema_separate_transport
checks.evidence: The compiled prompt carries only contract identity and schema digest; the JSON Schema remains in StructuredTransportRequest.json_schema.

checks.name: b1_prompt_under_12000_chars
checks.evidence: PromptBudgetGate preflights B1 at 12000 characters and the A4 test verifies rejection before provider I/O when an approved field exceeds the budget.

checks.name: b1_schema_under_4500_chars
checks.evidence: Canonical B1 schema is 3661 characters, below the frozen 4500-character ceiling.

checks.name: native_windows_binary_first
checks.evidence: The native adapter resolves claude.exe before any runner invocation and rejects a Windows .cmd-only candidate.

checks.name: one_scoped_contract_repair
checks.evidence: RepairBudget consumes only a validated ContractPatch within the supplied ViolationSet scope; a failed transport consumes no repair.

checks.name: i0_fact_extraction_signature
checks.evidence: I0 has a separate FactExtractionDraft schema and extractor core, with source-anchored facts only and no Director creative call.

checks.name: source_span_repair_ceiling
checks.evidence: ViolationSet rejects every I0 repair path except $.facts[n].source_start or $.facts[n].source_end.

checks.name: model_does_not_mint_ids_or_ticks
checks.evidence: B1 schema has no canonical ID or tick fields; local schema validation rejects model-supplied start_tick and legacy transport fields.

checks.name: typed_binding_intents_in_b1_schema
checks.evidence: B1 reference_binding_intents and dialogue_binding_intents exactly match their frozen v3.0 dataclasses, including shot and beat targets.

checks.name: free_text_not_binding_transport
checks.evidence: B1 no longer admits audio_intents or reference_intents; binding fields require typed responsibility or placement phase plus a validated opaque fact handle.

authority_boundary.model_authority: Draft and intent only; deterministic local code owns IDs, hashes, time, timeline, boundaries, bindings, VEC, and Projection.
authority_boundary.binding_authority: Only typed binding intents carrying approved opaque handles can enter B1 Draft transport; free text never establishes a binding.
authority_boundary.provider_authority: Native JSON Schema transport only, with claude.exe required on Windows and no tool access.

non_goals: No A5 deterministic assembler, raw tick allocation, VEC construction, or Projection work was started.
No v4 production path or production switch was modified.
No user-owned pre-existing worktree changes outside A4 allowed paths were modified or staged.
